findings.summary: escapeRegex escaped the basic-regex set but git log -G takes an extended regex: a created with +03:00 (outside writer) missed its carrier and B' listed the squash carrying the pin (fixed in 19ed4c7; macOS git probed 22/22, Linux git UNVERIFIED, the CI-run offset fixture self-checks it)

mutants survived round 1: trailer ignored in boundedCommits, <= -> < in the author-date drop, the final budget check; guards added in 19ed4c7 and observed red. M3 (T without --first-parent) is near-equivalent under rule 5 and carried as a note
a timed-out Part 0 result is never cached (decide D8, by design): on a repo where Part 0 exceeds 1.5 s, B3 and Part A stay silent; disclosure for the release note (measured 0.55-0.68 s here)

rule 5 carrier-path ancestry clause (src/pin-staleness.ts:284-285) had no guard: deleting "ancestor of C" left the suite green; fixed in 7000eb1 by row 11b (pre-pin-authored PR rebase-merged above the carrier -> STALE {O})
the T anchor (range ${T}..HEAD) can be removed with the suite green; rule 5 drops make T near-redundant (a distinguishing input needs clock skew, UNVERIFIED)
the cache key rule field has no guard (sameKey ignoring rule stays green); only one PIN_STALENESS_RULE version exists today
the D5 test (test/pin-floor-render.test.ts:125) is vacuous: constitutional is decision-only and isPinCandidate requires fact, so the guarded case is unreachable; pre-existing guard, not a defect
the PR body cites reviews/19ed4c73...json, renamed to reviews/bdd22b1c...json by 613e42c (now superseded by this record)
the L4 records enforce but do not store the observed modelUsage per trial; storing it would make ADR-0050 pinned-model observation auditable from the record alone
